title: 3.2.0 dev i Combo Pairing
symptom: In the Native Combo driver, after the APS finds the Bluetooth device, the user cannot enter the 10-digit pairing code because there is no enter or send button, so the pump closes the connection on timeout.
cause: The input field has a fixed width, causing the OK button to be hidden on certain screens.
fix: Put the device in landscape mode to press the OK button after entering the pairing code. A fix is also being made in pull request #2464.
evidence_quote: The input field has a fixed width in the moment, just put your device in landscape mode to press the ok button, after entering the pairing code.
